# MyEVStation

> EV charging station setup, site assessment and business partnership opportunities across India. Founded by ex-Indian Air Force veterans.

MyEVStation helps property owners, housing societies, commercial establishments, investors and entrepreneurs evaluate EV charging station opportunities. The site explains charger options, site and electrical feasibility, indicative investment assumptions and partnership pathways. Actual site suitability, costs, permissions, charger availability, utilisation and returns depend on technical assessment and written commercial agreements. Illustrative figures are not guarantees.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://myevstation.co/): EV charging station setup options and business pathways.
- [Why MyEVStation](https://myevstation.co/why-myevstation): Our approach to site suitability, planning and partnerships.
- [Business models](https://myevstation.co/business-model): Compare pathways for landowners, no-land investors, housing societies and ex-servicemen.
- [Technology](https://myevstation.co/technology): Charger selection, electrical readiness and safety considerations.
- [Investment guide](https://myevstation.co/ev-charging-investment-guide): Site feasibility, cost drivers and questions to ask before investing.
- [EV charging calculator](https://myevstation.co/ev-charging-calculator): An illustrative tool to explore assumptions; outputs are not guaranteed financial results.
- [Landowners](https://myevstation.co/with-land): Site assessment considerations for plots, commercial properties, parking and fleet locations.
- [No-land model](https://myevstation.co/without-land): Indicative equipment packages and operating assumptions.
- [Housing societies](https://myevstation.co/society): EV charging options for apartments, RWAs and residential parking.
- [Greater Noida societies](https://myevstation.co/greater-noida-societies): Local guidance for apartment complexes and RWAs.
- [Amritsar EV charging](https://myevstation.co/amritsar-ev-charging): Site assessment for commercial properties and housing societies in Amritsar.
- [Punjab EV charging](https://myevstation.co/punjab-ev-charging): City-wise site opportunity guidance across Punjab.
- [Ex-servicemen opportunities](https://myevstation.co/ex-servicemen): Veteran-focused EV charging business information.
- [Impact](https://myevstation.co/impact): Our mission and intended areas of impact.
- [FAQs](https://myevstation.co/faq): Answers about site assessment, costs, permissions and investment assumptions.
- [About us and partners](https://myevstation.co/about-us): Meet MyEVStation's leadership and partners.
- [Contact](https://myevstation.co/contact): Enquire about a site assessment or partnership.
- [XML sitemap](https://myevstation.co/sitemap.xml): Public indexable pages.
